intro: Become a superhero and protect your city from waves of bloodthirsty monsters destroying everything in their path.
description:
You'll love this epic fighting game with cool effects and 3D combo attacks.

At the start, your hero is just a simple stickman with no weapons or abilities. Defeat monsters with your bare hands, earn money, upgrade your hero, buy weapons, and fight huge bosses!

The entire environment is fully destructible: smash monsters, blow up cars, and demolish buildings.

If you love dynamic action games, this one will impress you with its fast controls and awesome features.

Combine different upgrades to become the strongest stickman hero!

As the game progresses, enemies grow stronger, and you'll have to fight for your survival. To defeat the toughest foes, your stickman-fighter will need maximum power upgrades.

We're sure you'll enjoy tons of upgrades for your stickmen heroes in the best action RPG experience.
